subject: Service impact and request for remediation credits
messages:
From: Ravi Gupta <ravi@aureliahealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurelia Health SRE <sre-team@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden 503 spike during scheduled billing run — request for credits

Hi Chloe,

We saw a sustained spike of 500/503 responses and token latency jumps on Aug 9 between 02:10–02:45 UTC during our daily billing reconciliation. This caused the reconciliation job to retry multiple times and delayed our downstream reporting; the window overlaps exactly with our SLAs. We collected traces and a sampling of failed requests — attached is a CSV with request ids and timestamps.

We appreciate Redwood's quick fix to the routing policy (thanks to Marcus for the heads-up), but the customer impact was material for us. Can you advise what goodwill compensation or trial extension you can apply while we evaluate moving more traffic?

Summary:
- Impact window: 2027-08-09 02:10–02:45 UTC
- Symptoms: 503s and token latencies +400–800ms above baseline
- Business impact: delayed billing reconciliation; manual intervention required

Looking for: token credit adjustment and a short trial extension for our pilot while we complete a failover test.

Thanks,
Ravi
Ravi Gupta
Head of Platform Engineering | Aurelia Health

Attachments: incident_log_20270809.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Gupta <ravi@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 503 spike during scheduled billing run — request for credits

Hi Ravi,

First, I'm really sorry for the disruption — thank you for the fast signal and for sharing the incident CSV. Marcus and I pulled the initial traces; we believe the spike was caused by a transient upstream routing mismatch combined with a hot shard on the model pool. We applied a routing override at 02:46 UTC which restored normal service.

Next steps:
- I escalated to our CS and finance partners to review a goodwill credit and a trial extension.
- Marcus is preparing a short incident timeline and a recommended customer-facing blurb for approval.
- Can you share any downstream cost you want us to consider (e.g., specific token billing for that reconciliation job)?

We want to move quickly — I'll come back with a concrete offer within 48 hours.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 503 spike during scheduled billing run — request for credits

Chloe — looping in Hannah for approval authority and Marcus for incident details. Suggested remediation package for Aurelia: 2,500 free token credits + 30-day trial extension + prioritized support hours (2 hrs) to run their failover test. Rationale: pilot account, clear impact window, and this keeps the pilot healthy without a formal SLA payout.

Marcus — can you confirm estimated tokens consumed by the reconciliation job during that window? I want to avoid under/over compensating.

Also attaching a draft of the customer-facing text I usually use for these offers (proposed_makegood_text.txt). If everyone is ok, I can send the offer to Ravi.

Attachments: proposed_makegood_text.txt

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 503 spike during scheduled billing run — request for credits

All,

Quick incident summary (for the offer):
- Root cause: temporary routing table mismatch + hot KV shard impacting one model pod cluster (region us-west-2).
- Remediation: routing override and automated re-shard at 02:46 UTC.
- Customer impact: ~36 failed calls (503) logged for the reconciliation job; ~120K extra tokens billed due to retries in the 35-minute window.
- Recommended offer: 2,500 free tokens (covers the extra plus buffer), 30-day trial extension, plus 2 hours of engineer support to validate their failover.

I've uploaded the incident traces and the runbook excerpt to Drive (see links). Happy to add a short, technical blurb for the outbound email.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE | Redwood Inference

Attachments: support_runbook_excerpt.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 503 spike during scheduled billing run — request for credits

Team,

Finance/legal reviewed — approved to proceed with a goodwill package capped at $3,500 USD in equivalent token credit for pilot accounts. The 2,500-token proposal is within that cap. Approve the 30-day extension as well; please add a short line confirming that this is a one-time remediation and does not constitute an admission of breach under our TOS.

If you want to add a DocuSign or amended order, loop me back — for this pilot-level comp, an email confirmation is sufficient.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Gupta <ravi@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Offer: token credits + trial extension for Aug 9 incident

Hi Ravi,

Thanks again for the data you sent — that helped us pinpoint the root cause and fix it quickly. We want to make this right while you complete your failover validation. Going to close with the package approved by our team:

Offer (one-time goodwill):
- 2,500 free token credits applied to your account (Aurelia Health — AUR-2391)
- 30-day trial extension from your current renewal date
- 2 hours of prioritized engineering time with Marcus and the SRE team to run/validate your failover runbook (scheduling separate)

Please note this is a one-time remediation offer and does not change the terms of our agreement. We will apply the credits to your account within 48 hours; I’ll confirm once applied. If the credits look good, tell me if you’d like the 2 hours for a remote session next week and what time zone works best.

Apologies again for the disruption. We appreciate Aurelia’s partnership and want to ensure the pilot runs smoothly.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0167

Attachment references: incident_log_20270809.csv (from Aurelia), proposed_makegood_text.txt (internal draft), support_runbook_excerpt.pdf (incident context)
